title: Security advisories published 2026-10-20 to 2026-10-22 against pinned packages turn two blocking dependency checks red on every run: the web lock (next critical and high; vitest/@vitest/mocker moderate; vite and its bundled launch-editor high; zod high) and the api tooling lock (certifi, filelock, setuptools, uv); main's scheduled audits are red since 2026-10-21
affects: Every run on every branch: CI jobs 'web-dependency-security' (step 'Blocking npm audit (--audit-level=low; dev deps included)') and 'exact-production-install' (step 'pip-audit - TOOLING lock must have ZERO advisories (blocking)') fail; first seen on the work branch at its head f5904860 (run 40268381775, 2026-10-26 04:18 UTC: 19 of 21 jobs success, these two failed; the head changed documents only).
main 065e3fb5: scheduled-python-audit and scheduled-web-audit red every day since 2026-10-21 (runs 39594074943 and 39599073207 first; last green 2026-10-20, runs 39415501845 and 39420053660).
No gate, acceptance or merge reads a green run until both locks are repaired (D-090 R639: CI green at the exact head).
detail: Read by the orchestrator on 2026-10-27 between 04:05 and 04:20 UTC. WEB (apps/web/package-lock.json; npm audit at f5904860: 5 vulnerabilities, 2 moderate, 2 high, 1 critical): next 15.5.27 (exact pin) affected by GHSA-2464-fhr4-w9xw (critical, unauthenticated remote code execution in the Image Optimization API with SVG files) and GHSA-p3m5-59mp-jv5r (high, denial of service in the App Router with Server Actions), both entered GitHub's database 2026-10-22 about 15:51Z, first patched in 15.5.28 (registry publication 2026-10-14T17:36:08.917Z); vitest 4.1.11 (exact pin) via @vitest/mocker 4.1.11: GHSA-qxg6-89mg-rqv8 and GHSA-xp26-3454-mjgp (medium, entered 2026-10-21), first patched 4.1.12 (vitest 2026-10-15T14:51:24.991Z, @vitest/mocker 2026-10-15T14:40:12.730Z); vite 7.3.6 (transitive, dev): GHSA-9jrq-w75r-8gcw (low), GHSA-rq7h-c2jc-7f22 (medium) and the bundled launch-editor GHSA-698v-4r3x-3vcv (medium), GHSA-r825-w8mm-5pxw (medium), GHSA-587h-7wmj-h5pm (high), first patched in vite 7.3.7 (2026-10-06T05:11:19.017Z); zod 4.6.5 (transitive, dev): GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 (high, entered 2026-10-01), first patched 4.6.6 (2026-10-11T16:18:23.878Z). Every fix version is older than 604800 s at this reading. API TOOLING (services/api/requirements-tools.lock; pip-audit --strict: 6 known vulnerabilities in 4 packages): certifi 2026.6.17 PYSEC-2026-4320, fix 2026.10.19 (PyPI 2026-10-20T02:24:15Z); filelock 3.29.7 CVE-2026-112907, CVE-2026-112913, CVE-2026-112940, fix 4.2.1 (2026-10-17T16:48:12Z); setuptools 83.0.0 GHSA-xmj3-9gf7-h52w, fix 84.1.0 (2026-10-19T20:11:41Z); uv 0.11.28 PYSEC-2026-4321 (alias GHSA-hq85-5cpj-mr62: the vendored root-certificate bundle still trusts a root whose intermediates were compromised and revoked), fix 0.13.4 (2026-10-20T15:11:02Z), which is NOT yet 604800 s old at this reading and becomes admissible at 2026-10-27T15:11:03Z. The production lock services/api/requirements.txt reports no known vulnerabilities; tools/codex_cli/package-lock.json reports 0. The fixes need no exception of any kind: exact pins (and exact overrides for the two web transitives) to the oldest advisory-free fix versions, the web lock regenerated and proven by .github/workflows/generate-lockfile.yml, the tooling lock regenerated byte-identically by services/api/scripts/lock_tools.sh with the new pinned uv, the age of uv 0.13.4 awaited rather than waived.
needs: Web: the pins and overrides moved, the lock regenerated and proven by the generate-lockfile workflow (never by hand), a security review (gate G5), a green web-dependency-security run.

API tooling: the four pins moved after uv 0.13.4 is 604800 s old (2026-10-27T15:11:03Z at the earliest), both locks proven byte-identical by their pinned generators, a security review (gate G5), a green exact-production-install run with zero findings on both locks.
Then one run on the work branch's head with every job a success before any gate, acceptance or merge reads it.
workaround_in_effect: None. No waiver exists or is sought; uv's age is awaited. Work that does not need a green run (building, local checks, reviews of a frozen head) continues; nothing is gated, accepted or merged on a red run.
candidate_followup: Two ledger tasks contracted in the same commit as this record on the work branch (one ledger-touching branch at a time): one for the web lock, one for the api tooling lock. This blocker is resolved when the work branch's run at a head containing both repairs completes with every job a success.
